item.title: Trump to address nation about Iran as he signals war could end within weeks
item.summary: Trump will deliver a primetime address on the Iran conflict, and the White House signaled an “important update" as the war enters a critical stage.

item.title: Reporter kidnapped in Baghdad known for pursuing gutsy, low-budget assignments while living ‘frugal existence’
item.summary: Award-winning American journalist Shelly Kittleson has been kidnapped in Iraq after brushing off threats that coincided with her coverage.

item.title: Nigeria's Christians on edge for Easter after Palm Sunday massacre
item.summary: Nigeria, ranked seventh-worst in the world for Christian persecution, saw a reported 28 killed on Palm Sunday, with fears Christians could be targeted this Easter.

item.title: Golf influencer Paige Spiranac shares words of encouragement for Tiger Woods after DUI arrest
item.summary: Golf influencer Paige Spiranac posted words of encouragement for Tiger Woods after his DUI arrest last week, saying "we are all rooting for Tiger."

item.title: ‘Virginia father’ charged with murdering infant daughter is illegal alien, says DHS
item.summary: A “Virginia father" charged with beating his infant daughter to death is an illegal immigrant let into the country under the Biden administration, according to DHS.

item.title: Sauer cites ‘striking’ figures on secretive birth tourism in high-stakes SCOTUS case
item.summary: Trump's executive order seeks to reinterpret the 14th Amendment to deny citizenship to children of illegal immigrants. The Supreme Court heard oral arguments Wednesday.

item.title: Ted Bundy unmasked in decades-old teen murder as cold case finally solved by DNA: report
item.summary: New DNA technology linked Ted Bundy to the 1974 Halloween murder of Utah teen Laura Ann Aime, 51 years after her disappearance, officials confirmed.

item.title: Jen Shah, Theranos' Elizabeth Holmes bonded in prison over 'poop duty' responsibilities
item.summary: "Real Housewives" star Jen Shah says she grew close to Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes over shared "poop duty" and late-night walks at FPC Bryan in Texas.

item.title: Trump hypes moon mission as Artemis II prepares to lift off under pressure from past failures
item.summary: Trump celebrated Artemis II as astronauts including Jeremy Hansen prepare to travel around the moon, the first crewed deep-space mission since 1972.

item.title: Ukraine signals progress on US security guarantees after call with Trump envoys
item.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says talks with Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner showed progress on Ukraine security guarantees, calling for a leaders' summit to advance peace.
